research_question: Does an unusually large, broad-market-relative volume shock add forward alpha after controlling for the same day's price strength?
mechanism_hypothesis: A strong close accompanied by an exceptional increase in participation reflects information-driven demand whose price impact diffuses over subsequent sessions.

event_definition.universe: SH/SZ stocks with adjusted close from CNY 3 to 300 and signal-day amount at least CNY 20 million
event_definition.price_confirmation: positive close-to-close return, close in the top 30% of the daily range, and same-day return percentile at least 80 among eligible stocks
event_definition.volume_shock: signal-day volume divided by the strictly prior 20-valid-session median volume
event_definition.candidate: volume-shock percentile at least 90 among eligible stocks on the signal date
event_definition.matched_control: same-date price-confirmed stock with volume-shock percentile from 40 through 60, chosen by nearest return percentile and then symbol
event_definition.event_identity: retain only the first candidate event for a stock within each 20-valid-session cooldown

execution: Signal after the completed daily bar and enter at the next common market session open when the stock is tradable.
success_action: Freeze this exact event definition and run it once on 2023-01-03 through the available 2026 data.
failure_action: Stop abnormal-demand threshold and window variants and return to the mechanism map.
constraints: Do not inspect 2023-2026 outcomes unless every training gate passes.
Do not scan return ranks, volume ranks, close location, median window, cooldown or holding horizon.
Do not add VCP, market-regime, exit, position or portfolio filters.
